rules.name: xoga747-01-market-parser-runs-and-configs
rules.sql: SELECT code, template_type, template_name, length(rule_data::text) AS rule_chars, created_timestamp, updated_timestamp, updated_by, tenant_id FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE template_name ILIKE '%option%' OR template_name ILIKE '%market%' OR template_name ILIKE '%financial%' OR template_name ILIKE '%china%' OR template_name ILIKE '%ice%' OR template_name ILIKE '%parser%' ORDER BY template_name, created_timestamp DESC

SELECT original_file_name, status, upload_for, import_as, file_size, start_time, completion_time, created_by, created_timestamp FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history WHERE created_timestamp >= :since ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT execution_id, min(created_timestamp) AS first_step_at, count(*) AS steps, max(output_row_count) AS max_rows_out, min(output_row_count) AS min_rows_out FROM opera.pipeline_execution_step_log WHERE created_timestamp >= :since GROUP BY execution_id ORDER BY min(created_timestamp) DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT execution_id, step_number, step_type, step_name, input_row_count, output_row_count, rejected_row_count, warning_count, execution_duration, step_status, created_timestamp FROM opera.pipeline_execution_step_log WHERE execution_id IN (:r.execution_id[]) ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC, execution_id, step_number

SELECT template_name, template_type, created_timestamp, rule_data::text AS rule_text FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE template_name ILIKE '%financial%' OR template_name ILIKE '%china%' ORDER BY template_name, created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT pm.bbg_product_code, pm.invenio_product_code, pm.asset_class, pm.status, pm.tenant_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.vol_id_table v WHERE v.product_code = pm.invenio_product_code) AS vol_id_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.underlying_list_table u WHERE u.invenio_product_code = pm.invenio_product_code) AS underlying_rows FROM opera.product_master_table pm WHERE pm.bbg_product_code IN ('BJ','IR','JB','XM','YM','YPO','ZB', 'AC','AE','BDR','BP','KKP','KO','LMA','OMR','OR','PAL','RT','SH','SRB','VV','ZRO','ZRR') ORDER BY pm.bbg_product_code

a Financial and a China pipeline config
